environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with default transaction isolation (READ COMMITTED). The wallets table has no RLS policies enabled - tenant isolation is enforced purely at the application layer via the x-tenant-id header check in queries. The SET app.current_tenant command is issued but no RLS policy references it. Connection pooling via PgBouncer in transaction mode. No rate limiting on the transfer endpoint. Multiple service replicas handle concurrent requests.
